sql.smartlist.get: select s.*, ot.object_type from flow.smartlist s inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = s.company_object_type_id inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id
sql.smartlist.getById: select s.*, ot.object_type from flow.smartlist s inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = s.company_object_type_id inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id where s.id = :id;
sql.smartlist.update: update flow.smartlist set name = :name, company_object_type_id = :companyObjectTypeId, shared = :shared, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :id;
sql.smartlist.getAvailableFields: select sf.id as "smartlistFieldId", null as "customFieldGroupAssignmentId", sf.name as "name", null as "processStepId", null as "processStepName", cdt.data_type_id as "dataTypeId" from flow.smartlist_field sf inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = sf.company_object_type_id inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id inner join flow.company_data_type cdt on cdt.id = sf.company_data_type_id where ot.id = :objectTypeId and cot.company_id = :companyId and cot.archived is not true union select null as "smartlistFieldId", cfga.id as "customFieldGroupAssignmentId", cf.field_name as "name", ps.id as "processStepId", ps.process_step_name as "processStepName", cdt.data_type_id as "dataTypeId" from flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = cfg.company_object_type_id left join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = cfg.process_step_id inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id inner join flow.company_data_type cdt on cdt.id = cf.company_data_type_id where ot.id = :objectTypeId and cot.company_id = :companyId and cfga.ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id is null and cfga.archived is not true and cfg.archived is not true order by name, "processStepName";
sql.smartlist.getAssignedFields: select sfa.id, sfa.smartlist_id, sfa.smartlist_field_id, sfa.custom_field_group_assignment_id, sfa.archived, sfa.display_order, ot.object_type, case when sfa.custom_field_group_assignment_id is not null then ps.process_step_name else ps1.process_step_name end as process_step_name, case when sfa.smartlist_field_id is not null then sf.name else cf.field_name end as name from flow.smartlist_field_assignment sfa left join flow.smartlist_field sf on sf.id = sfa.smartlist_field_id left join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = sf.company_object_type_id left join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = sfa.custom_field_group_assignment_id left join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id left join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id left join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = cfg.process_step_id left join flow.process_step ps1 on ps1.id = sfa.process_step_id where sfa.smartlist_id = :id and sfa.archived is not true order by sfa.display_order;
sql.smartlist.getAssignedFieldById: select sfa.id, sfa.smartlist_id, sfa.smartlist_field_id, sfa.custom_field_group_assignment_id, sfa.archived, sfa.display_order, ot.object_type, ps.process_step_name, case when sfa.custom_field_group_assignment_id is not null then ps.process_step_name else ps1.process_step_name end as process_step_name, case when sfa.smartlist_field_id is not null then sf.name else cf.field_name end as name from flow.smartlist_field_assignment sfa left join flow.smartlist_field sf on sf.id = sfa.smartlist_field_id left join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = sf.company_object_type_id left join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = sfa.custom_field_group_assignment_id left join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id left join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id left join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = cfg.process_step_id left join flow.process_step ps1 on ps1.id = sfa.process_step_id where sfa.id = :id and sfa.archived is not true;
sql.smartlist.deleteField: update flow.smartlist_field_assignment set archived = true, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :id;
sql.smartlist.updateDisplayOrder: update flow.smartlist_field_assignment set display_order = :displayOrder, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :id;
sql.smartlist.getRequirementById: select sr.*, ot.object_type, opt.operator_type, case when sr.custom_field_group_assignment_id is not null then ps.process_step_name else ps1.process_step_name end as process_step_name, case when sr.smartlist_field_id is not null then sf.name else cf.field_name end as name, case when sr.data_type_requirement_id is null then null else json_build_object( 'id', dtr.id, 'dataTypeValue', dtr.data_type_value, 'secondaryRequirement', dtr.secondary_requirement ) end as data_type_requirement from flow.smartlist_requirement sr inner join flow.smartlist s on s.id = sr.smartlist_id left join flow.smartlist_field sf on sf.id = sr.smartlist_field_id left join flow.company_object_type cot1 on cot1.id = sf.company_object_type_id left join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot1.object_type_id inner join flow.operator_type opt on opt.id = sr.operator_type_id left join flow.process_step ps1 on ps1.id = sr.process_step_id left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = sr.custom_field_group_assignment_id left join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id left join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id left join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = cfg.process_step_id left join flow.data_type_requirement dtr on dtr.id = sr.data_type_requirement_id where sr.id = :requirementId and sr.archived is not true;
sql.smartlist.getRequirements: select sr.*, ot.object_type, opt.operator_type, case when sr.custom_field_group_assignment_id is not null then ps.process_step_name else ps1.process_step_name end as process_step_name, case when sr.smartlist_field_id is not null then sf.name else cf.field_name end as name, case when sr.data_type_requirement_id is null then null else json_build_object( 'id', dtr.id, 'dataTypeValue', dtr.data_type_value, 'secondaryRequirement', dtr.secondary_requirement ) end as data_type_requirement from flow.smartlist_requirement sr inner join flow.smartlist s on s.id = sr.smartlist_id inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = s.company_object_type_id left join flow.smartlist_field sf on sf.id = sr.smartlist_field_id left join flow.company_object_type cot1 on cot1.id = sf.company_object_type_id left join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot1.object_type_id inner join flow.operator_type opt on opt.id = sr.operator_type_id left join flow.process_step ps1 on ps1.id = sr.process_step_id left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = sr.custom_field_group_assignment_id left join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id left join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id left join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = cfg.process_step_id left join flow.data_type_requirement dtr on dtr.id = sr.data_type_requirement_id where sr.smartlist_id = :smartlistId and cot.company_id = :companyId and sr.archived is not true order by sr.display_order;
sql.smartlist.deleteRequirement: update flow.smartlist_requirement set archived = true, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :requirementId
sql.smartlist.getLogic: select sl.id, sl.smartlist_id, sl.smartlist_requirement_id, sl.operation_type_id, ot.operation_type, ot.operation_code, sl.sql_order, sl.created_by_id, sl.date_created, sl.modified_by_id, sl.date_modified, sl.archived, sr.display_order from flow.smartlist_logic sl left join flow.operation_type ot on ot.id = sl.operation_type_id left join flow.smartlist_requirement sr on sr.id = sl.smartlist_requirement_id where sl.smartlist_id = :smartlistId and sl.archived is not true order by sl.sql_order;
sql.smartlist.archiveLogic: update flow.smartlist_logic set archived = true, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where smartlist_id = :smartlistId;
sql.smartlist.updateLogic: insert into flow.smartlist_logic (smartlist_id, smartlist_requirement_id, operation_type_id, sql_order, created_by_id) values (:smartlistId, :smartlistRequirementId, :operationTypeId, :sqlOrder, :userId);
